description: Recording activity from all 6,016 valid geolocated mammal observations in the supplied dataset. Observation dates cover 2017–2026. Observation data are embedded; state boundaries load from australia-states.json. Geographic bins stay fixed while zooming. Distinct species are counted using taxon ID with name fallback. Counts reflect reporting effort and wildlife presence, not animal abundance; cell area varies with latitude and obscured coordinates can affect assignments. State boundaries: https://github.com/rowanhogan/australian-states. Scroll to zoom, drag to pan, and click Reset view or double-click to reset. Uses Vega for direct map gestures and a visible reset button. Occupied cells are drawn as circles at their geographic centres; circle diameter scales with the cell width and zoom. The observation-count legend uses matching circles. Colour indicates observation counts. A map-centre name annotation sits on the blue ocean beside Australia with a leader line to the selected map centre; it hides when the selected location is offscreen. No circle highlight or default regional callouts. Overview callouts identify Brisbane–Gold Coast and Melbourne recording clusters using fixed regional bounding-box totals. They hide when a map centre is selected or zoom exceeds 1200 to keep the detailed view clear. Uses the 10 most recent available observation years (2017–2026), including partial 2026. Bin colours use a sequential blue luminance scale: lighter bins have fewer observations and darker bins have more; legend thresholds are unchanged.
